question: Which three years in 2012-2017 have the smallest absolute difference between median revenue and median functional expenses for organizations filing IRS 990 forms? Please output three years and respective differences.

WITH yearly_medians AS (
  SELECT '2012' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2012`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2012`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2013' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2014' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2015' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2016' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2017' AS year,
    (SELECT AVG(totrevenue) FROM (
      SELECT totrevenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totrevenue) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_revenue,
    (SELECT AVG(totfuncexpns) FROM (
      SELECT totfuncexpns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY totfuncexpns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
      FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017`
      WHERE totrevenue IS NOT NULL AND totfuncexpns IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn IN ((total + 1) / 2, (total + 2) / 2)) AS median_funcexpns
)
SELECT year, median_revenue, median_funcexpns,
       ABS(median_revenue - median_funcexpns) AS abs_diff
FROM yearly_medians
ORDER BY abs_diff ASC
LIMIT 3
